title: Let the little children come to me

request.style: English, soulful female solo voice with warm gospel choir, acoustic piano, gentle strings, soft drums, handclaps, hopeful and tender mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Disciples stood in the way
Told the parents to go away
But Jesus looked with grace
Saw the small face

[Chorus]
Let the little children come to me
And do not hinder them
For the kingdom of heaven belongs
To such as these

[Verse]
Hands placed on the head
A prayer softly said
The disciples rebuked
But Jesus spoke

[Chorus]
Let the little children come to me
And do not hinder them
For the kingdom of heaven belongs
To such as these

[Verse]
Not everyone can accept
This word is unique
Given to those who can receive
With a humble eye

[Chorus]
Let the little children come to me
And do not hinder them
For the kingdom of heaven belongs
To such as these

[Bridge]
He went on from there
With love to share
The good question asked
By the man in the past

[Outro]
There is only one who is good
Keep the commandments
Enter life
